**Concept-film rule.** One headline plus at most one auxiliary label at a time. Captions sit at the bottom centre,
clear of the rover and the formula panel.

## New captures for V3

All captures use the virtual-clock harness: deterministic 30 fps from the live site. The fps probe read 60 fps
(quality 2).

| Capture | Script | Settings | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `F_w1g` | `scripts/capture_v3b.js` | 1920×1080 CSS at **DPR 1.5**; frames captured at 2880×1620 device pixels | W1 explainer with Gobi G-1; F1, F2 and F5 sweeps |
| `G_lab2` | `scripts/capture_v3b.js` | Same | Expedition Lab with scripted scroll holds on the resolution check, the NOT MEASURED list, and the key-measurement formulas. The 1.5× density keeps the formula crops (1.75–1.86× zoom) at or near native sharpness. |

- **Earlier exploratory takes.** `F_w1` (Qaidam selected by default) and `G_lab` (continuous scroll), from
  `scripts/capture_v3.js`, were superseded and not used.
- **Rover.** `E_rover` is reused from V2 (2560×1440 CSS, DPR 1.5, viewport clipped at device pixels).

## Narration

- **Engine.** Kokoro-82M `af_heart`, US English, speed 1.1, 7 takes (`audio/v3/af_heart/`, script
  `scripts/tts_v3.py`).
- **Alternative.** `af_bella` takes were also generated (`audio/v3/af_bella/`); they run slightly longer.
- **Script.** The proposed script was used with one cut ("Explore both worlds at matched scale" was dropped to keep
  "using Wasserstein distance" clear of the rover reveal). "An illustration, not physics." is a separate take.
- **Checks.** The ASR transcript of the final MP4 is word-perfect, including "Wasserstein".
- **Listening.** **Not auditioned by ear**: this session has no audio output.

## Audio

| Element | Details |
|---|---|
| Score | Original synthesized score (`scripts/music_v2.py timeline_v3.json`) |
| Arc | Atmosphere → discovery (F-major lift with feature ticks at each F1–F5 line) → **rover impact + brass swell + percussion at 10.20 s** → focused lab pulse → A-sus tension under the resolution check → Dmaj9 resolve |
| SFX | Synthesized motor hum and terrain grains under the drive; servo whirs on the mast scan |
| Mix | `scripts/mix_v2.py timeline_v3.json` |
| Ducking | Music −21 dB and SFX −11 dB under the voice |
| Voice separation | 13–21 dB above music + SFX in every narrated section; the score swells 12–14 dB louder in the voice-free rover and lab gaps |
| Master (MP4, EBU R128) | −15.0 LUFS integrated, LRA 3.1 LU, true peak −1.5 dBTP |

## Rebuild

```bash
python3 scripts/make_timeline_v3.py
.venv-tts/bin/python scripts/music_v2.py timeline_v3.json
.venv-tts/bin/python scripts/mix_v2.py timeline_v3.json
./scripts/encode_v3.sh
```
